protocol: AUROC of stored OOF probabilities vs gold labels; rank-avg recomputed here
interpretation: oof_probs.npz holds the NESTED OOF probabilities (C chosen by inner LOCO per outer fold), not the fixed-hyperparameter ones. Recomputing AUROC straight from these stored probabilities reproduces the published NESTED values exactly: EG2 0.8458 (published 0.846), pixel 0.7916 (0.792), prob-avg 0.8336 (0.834), rank-avg recomputed here 0.8440 (0.844). The slightly higher non-nested figures (0.848 / 0.810 / 0.853 / 0.856) come from the fixed-C experiment (tools/port/ensemble_views_exploratory.py) which I verified separately. So BOTH families are now reproduced: the nested set from raw probabilities (this file), the non-nested set from the feature/embedding caches. The earlier caveat that the nested AUROCs 'could not be recomputed from scratch because the raw probs are not in the artifact' is RETRACTED - they are, and they agree.
